verdict.rationale: Streaming session audio to an external transcription or realtime model endpoint is a fair question for a live-streaming service, so the axis applies. The pack only covers ingest, low-latency delivery, S3 recording, server-side composition to IVS channels, and EventBridge monitoring. None of these forwards live audio to a model endpoint while the session runs, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running
